range_add_range_min.repair_reason: Original authored shared segment tree maintained an unused range sum; full native range-add sequences could overflow that unused 64-bit sum. This independent strict implementation stores only min/max and lazy additions; these are bounded by (Q+1)*10^9, below signed64 at native and expanded caps.

maximum_independent_set.repair_reason: Raw/L2 clique-complement algorithm is unchanged; its fixed bitset capacity is increased from40 to42 to support the expanded original N bound. Native L3 remains at original N<=40.
